The explicitly added external ayat 1:2-1:7 were quarantined during Phase 1 and reviewed in Phase 2. Their repeated mercy and day terminology did not create a non-redundant, focus-local carrier-trigger delta beyond the declared pericope, so no external overlay finding was retained.

The six HFT records are exact-pericope but legacy_unbound. They are retained as attributed evidence only where their supplied coordinates, roles, and focus returns agree; unresolved branch records carry null gloss and facet fields.
The palm-harvest finding is bounded to its supplied 19:23, 19:25, and 19:26 anchors; no unsupported extension beyond that declared evidence was used.
